new_code_boundaries.off: Worker observer installation/export off returns before reading worker/runner/source/factory. Separate explicit source-identity audit RPC runs in both future GPU modes and is not the optional observer.
new_code_boundaries.owner_lifetime: Connection retains weak runner/method/factory refs and copied scalar frames. Observation Event pairs are bounded (128 pending pairs,4096 steps), query-only and cleared on detach/invalid. No native handler/owner/tensor/Future is retained.
new_code_boundaries.exceptions: Ordinary observer Exception invalidates observation and preserves original once/identity/error path. Original BaseException same object propagates without retry. Observer KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit transparently cancels (begin may cancel before original execution, finish after original sample may cancel after completed work); this matches frozen scalar connector, never a retry/evidence of unexecuted sampling.
new_code_boundaries.timing: Raw current-stream CUDA Event elapsed diagnostics may be observed only in the future authorized GPU process. No synchronize/wait, no hostclock mapping, gpu_elapsed_ns and wall endpoints stay None; diagnostic qualification properties are invariant False.
new_code_boundaries.native_io: none. NativeWindowJournal/StageAccounting/native AIO pipeline and native cache engine are not replaced. This scope does not create an owned native I/O handler, hence native drain is not_applicable, never synthetic all-zero DrainEvidence.
new_code_boundaries.shutdown: Only original EngineCore shutdown releases original model resources. Observer detach removes its own wrappers/events; it does not credit physical GPU release or drain a native owner.
new_code_boundaries.source_binding: New G2 lock must include all unchanged 2052 frozen G1 source refs plus new runner/worker/plan/frozen scalar/frame, author runtime APIs, exact old binary fallback, Torch decorator file, original model-plan and all11 current payload+saved provider evidence. G1 lock itself preserved, not reused as G2 lock.
